decisions.reason: As an older German wood-products firm, we would likely tolerate one more year for this adjacent but less core, electronics-linked Christmas item because there is no clear evidence yet that its results fall below aspiration by enough to justify redeploying resources.

This product fits the firm's core woodworking and traditional seasonal market closely, so absent negative signals its performance is likely at or near aspiration and there is little reason to drop it.

The figurine remains close to the firm's established craft capabilities while testing a more modern design, so behavioral-theory logic suggests keeping it unless clearer underperformance triggers problemistic search.
